title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-p4bl: stale comment in OscoreSeqNum::increment docs referencing u32::MAX instead of Self::MAX
description:
## Issue

In `rust/lichen-oscore/src/seqnum.rs`, the doc comments for `increment` (line 55) and `fetch_increment` (line 72) reference `u32::MAX`:

```rust
/// Returns `None` if the sequence number is at `u32::MAX` (would overflow).
```

But `OscoreSeqNum` now uses a 40-bit `MAX` value `(1 << 40) - 1`. The comment should say `Self::MAX` or "the maximum 40-bit value."

## Location

`rust/lichen-oscore/src/seqnum.rs:55` and `:72`
